prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape HD-2D game render reference for 香港像素漫游, a quiet walkable Hong Kong RPG, inspired by Octopath Traveler's pixel sprites in lit three-dimensional environments. This is concept art for Unity, not a photograph, map, collage, poster or UI.

INPUT ROLES: image 1 is a north-up GIS layout controlling geographic relationships, NOT the final composition. Image 2 is the actual Tsim Sha Tsui A1 glass entrance in August 2024, controlling entrance architecture and adjacent aging shop facade. Image 3 is Haiphong Road looking west, controlling the tree canopy, raised park retaining wall on north/right and shops on south/left. Image 4 is Kowloon Mosque July 2026, controlling its white facade, arched screens, dome, palms and bus shelters/stop poles. Preserve this geography. Reinterpret all textures as cohesive pixel art; don't paste photos.

CAMERA: fixed everyday HD-2D exploration camera from EAST looking WEST, approximately 30 degrees downward from horizontal, weak perspective, landscape 16:9. Nathan Road runs horizontally across the LOWER foreground, NORTH is screen RIGHT. Haiphong Road branches away WEST into DEPTH at the left-center. Place the glass A1 pavilion on the NORTH/RIGHT side of that branch mouth. Kowloon Mosque sits further RIGHT of A1, on the same WEST side of Nathan Road, palms and green-roof bus shelters in front. Shops with tightly spaced windows, AC units and red/gold jewellery shop signs are LEFT/SOUTH of Haiphong Road. Park trees and raised stone retaining wall recede along the RIGHT/NORTH side of Haiphong behind A1. Do not turn Haiphong into stairs or merge the roads; leave its branch clearly visible. No harbor, hills, cable cars, misplaced Harbour City/Apple Store/K11.

ART: handcrafted crisp pixel texture clusters on low-poly 3D volumes, small 2D sprite people with readable feet, physically coherent warm late-afternoon daylight and cool tree shadows, restrained bloom, subtle foreground/background depth of field, sharp walkable midground. NOT smooth toy plastic, not photoreal buildings, not isometric floating diorama. Buildings can crop at the upper edge; preserve overlapping walls, awnings, side facades, stairs confined to actual entrances. No vast empty plaza.

LIFE: small white-robed wizard protagonist with a tall triangular white hat, about 1/18 frame height, walking on the west sidewalk between A1 and bus shelters. Modest pedestrians entering/leaving A1, short passenger queue at red KMB poles, people passing independently, no blocked pedestrian corridor. One red/cream double-decker at the WEST curb in front of mosque, nose pointing screen RIGHT/north, on Hong Kong's left-hand traffic side. Other cars unobtrusive. Accurate sidewalk paving, curb, railings, drain covers, street signs and shaded canopy. Important labels only 'A1', '尖沙咀站', 'Haiphong Road'; lettering is provisional artwork. Avoid invented giant neon, fantasy architecture, decorative HUD, title text, watermark. Show a believable continuous walk from horizontal sidewalk into the depth branch.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the FIRST image, retaining its HD-2D pixel-textured 3D rendering, sunny lighting, camera, A1 glass pavilion, mosque at screen right and northbound bus. Supporting images 2-5 are the verified map, A1 photo, Haiphong photo and mosque photo.
CRITICAL GEOGRAPHIC CORRECTION: The left-center Haiphong Road has incorrectly become a tiled pedestrian alley. Restore it as a clearly visible continuous ASPHALT VEHICULAR STREET which joins the foreground Nathan Road at a proper T-junction. It runs from the foreground left-center back into depth, with separate pavements on each side: shops on left/south, raised park wall and trees on right/north. Widen its vehicular carriageway enough for the real two visible traffic lanes, with dashed white divider and yellow curb markings. Remove the fence that currently blocks the mouth. Keep pavements and pedestrians alongside, not standing in the carriageway. Add one small car coming toward the junction, without blocking the view. Do not create an extra road or move the mosque, A1 or shops to the opposite side. Preserve north = right in screen coordinates and the main Nathan Road horizontal composition.
Make the protagonist a simple tiny white-robed wizard with a tall triangular white conical hat, no broad floppy brim, no blue hair or oversized backpack, feet clearly planted on the sidewalk. All other buildings, lighting, parked bus, pixel material density and camera remain consistent. Artwork reference only; no labels outside the scene.

Use case: lighting-weather. Edit the supplied HD-2D Hong Kong concept to blue-hour just after a light shower. Preserve EXACTLY the same camera, road geometry, A1 pavilion, Haiphong asphalt T-junction on the left, shops south/left of Haiphong, park trees north/right, Kowloon Mosque on right, shelter and bus positions, pedestrian paths and pixel-textured 3D art. Change only light, wetness and pedestrian umbrellas: blue ambient dusk, warm storefront lighting, softly lit A1, restrained glass reflections and wet curb patches, dark tree silhouette. No flooding, no thick fog, no giant neon, no extra landmarks or signs. Keep the player's walking sidewalk and feet clearly visible and sharply focused; subtle depth of field only in extreme foreground and far distance. Maintain believable small pixel NPCs and the white-robed small wizard protagonist with tall triangular white hat. Main Nathan Road remains horizontal; Haiphong is a VEHICULAR street leading into depth, NOT stairs or pedestrian alley. Hong Kong left-hand traffic, bus nose to screen right/north. Same framing, no UI, title or watermark. This is a design lighting scenario, not evidence of actual night operations.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one landscape HD-2D exploration-game concept of walking WEST into Haiphong Road from Nathan Road, Hong Kong, for 香港像素漫游. Input 1 is north-up GIS plan to preserve sides and connections, input 2 the real Haiphong westward street photograph, input 3 the established daytime concept to match pixel-textured three-dimensional rendering. Images 1 and 3 are NOT photos. Preserve input 2's real arrangement: aging commercial buildings with crowded shop awnings and AC units on LEFT/SOUTH, narrow pedestrian sidewalk and a substantial weathered stone retaining wall with trees and pink-tiled utility building on RIGHT/NORTH. A tree canopy overlaps the upper picture and distant street facades. Haiphong is an asphalt vehicular street, not an alley of stairs, not a pedestrian mall. Its two lanes remain distinct from pavements. It extends diagonally from the lower-left foreground toward upper-center depth. No harbor, mountain, relocated mosque, fantasy bridge or invented side alley. Nathan Road is behind the camera in this closer view.

Camera is a raised fixed game camera ~30 degrees downward, weak perspective, close enough to read player feet and sidewalk width, NOT eye-height photo or overhead map. Pixel-cluster surfaces and small crisp sprite humans inspired by Octopath Traveler, lit 3D buildings, contact shadows, very restrained depth of field beyond the playable zone, no photographic backdrop or plastic voxel blocks. Landscape 16:9. A continuous clear right-hand walking sidewalk leads into depth, with curb, drain covers, brick paving, railing and road signs based on photo. One tiny white-robed wizard with a simple tall triangular white conical hat (no broad floppy brim, no backpack), seen three-quarter from behind walking into the street's depth. Diverse everyday passersby, a person waiting near a shop, one shop worker with hand trolley and two cartons fully on the shop-side pavement (a proposed activity, not a factual scheduled event); do not obstruct the path. A small van in the road coming east toward camera, car spacing readable. Soft afternoon light filtered through canopy; old walls, awning shadows, foliage overlap and foreground framing create depth. Shop signs can use the photo's 'UPSO' and 'mannings' as dated 2024 visual references; small other lettering remains blank or indistinct for later typography. No 7-Eleven/Apple/McDonald's inserted without photo evidence. No giant labels, UI, title, watermarks. Keep this a practical rendering reference for modular buildings, retaining wall, vehicles, foliage, pavement and separate sprite layers.
